description: This file defines the `AccountPickerDialogFragment` class, which is a dialog fragment that displays a list of target accounts (excluding the current account) for the user to choose from, primarily for moving notes between accounts.

classes.name: AccountPickerDialogFragment
classes.description: A dialog fragment that allows the user to pick an account to move a note to, excluding the current account.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes the listener and target accounts list, filtering out the current account.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns the dialog UI displaying account options or a message if no other accounts are available.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Sets soft input mode for the dialog window.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of `AccountPickerDialogFragment` with provided target accounts and current account ID.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Overrides branding application; no implementation here.
